# RSVP Status

## Summary
Where someone stands on attending something — the answer to an invitation,
not the payment for it and not the turnstile scan. Shared-realm block at
`rsvp-status-field.gts`, built on the `statusField` factory, so consumers get
constrained dropdowns, state pills and the `nextStatuses`/`canTransition`
helpers for free.

## Vocabulary
Invited → Going / Maybe / Waitlisted / Declined, with every answer allowed to
change (people change their minds up to the doors opening) except returning
to Invited — an answer, once given, can change but not un-happen. Nothing is
terminal.

## Usage
```ts
import RsvpStatusField from '../rsvp-status-field';

@field rsvp = contains(RsvpStatusField);
```
Consumers with a different vocabulary (a wedding's "Attending with guest")
build their own via `statusField`; this export is the common five-answer
form.

## Example
Serializes as a plain string, so `containedExamples` cannot hold one — the
in-use example is the Booking card's `rsvp` field in this realm (linked once
that block lands; see its Spec).

## Non-goals
Payment state and attendance are different facts: a booking can be Going and
unpaid, or Going and never checked in. Those live as their own fields
(payment status, `checkedInAt`) on the consumer.
